role: kick (dual-mono close) — dompeak 58.6 Hz (good sub), beater click up top. Bonham: keep WEIGHT.
rationale: Keep the 58 Hz sub (do NOT cut it — it's the Bonham weight); only a gentle -2 @350 to ease box. No click boost (dark). New(FF) 3:1 Medium comp for body; 550 EQ fully flat (no low-mid scoop). declick off.

role: snare top (dual-mono) — BRIGHT (centroid 5580, tilt -0.03), body at ~200. Bonham: deep+fat, ghost notes intact, no air, no gate.
rationale: No de-box (250-400 already ~-10 dB → cutting would only brighten this already-bright snare). Keep the body. A gentle 4.5-7k dynamic de-harsh tames the bright edge ONLY when it spikes (the snare is the one bright element). NO air, NO transient snap, NO gate — natural body + ghost notes (Bonham). 550 flat. declick off.

role: overheads (stereo) — kit image + hats/cymbals (no separate hat mic). Box/kick-bleed at 200. Bonham: warm, just under the room.
rationale: HPF 110 + a gentle -2 @200 clear the kick-bleed/box (dompeak 199 = bleed, not warmth here). Dynamic 3-6.3k de-harsh tames cymbal/hat edge only when it rings. NO air (dark), NO low-mid cuts in the 550 (keep warmth). Old(FB) 2.5:1 for cohesion. corr 0.66 preserved. declick off.

role: room/ambience (stereo) — THE STAR. centroid 2547 (already dark), corr 0.83. Bonham: keep it WARM, ALIVE, BIG; keep the lows.
rationale: The room is the Bonham sound — treat lightly and KEEP ITS LOW WEIGHT: HPF only 45 (warm recipe used 120; Bonham keeps the bottom) + one gentle -1.5 @200 to ease box. Light 2.5-6k de-harsh keeps it alive. Old(FB) 2:1 @0.3 s for character/glue without crushing the natural 28.8 crest (the dynamics ARE the vibe). NO air. Pushed FORWARD in the balance. declick off.

role: snare reverb (FX return, stereo, corr -0.12 = wide tail). Bonham: KEEP it as ambience; clean the low-mid wash that loosened the warm low end.
rationale: FX return, not a mic — so just CLEAN it: HPF 150 removes the low-mid wash that loosened the warm bus's low end (the reason the warm pass dropped it), keeping the ambient sheen. Gentle 4-7k de-harsh on the bright reverb edge. NO comp (let the tail breathe), 550 flat. Folded in LOW in the balance as ambience — A/B'd with/without in Stage 4b.
